name: Cigna
description: Cigna is two businesses of very different size. Evernorth, built around the Express Scripts pharmacy benefit manager and the Accredo specialty pharmacy, produced 85 percent of 2025 adjusted revenue ($235.0 billion) and about 73 percent of pre-tax adjusted profit: it manages drug benefits and dispenses drugs for health plans and employers, many of them other insurers' members. Cigna Healthcare is the insurance arm, mainly employer-funded health plans where the employer bears the claims and Cigna is paid fees, plus international health and dental. In March 2025 Cigna sold its Medicare Advantage and stand-alone Part D businesses to Health Care Service Corporation, making it far less exposed to Medicare rates than UnitedHealth, Humana or Elevance.

gics.note: Conventional filing: Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (read 2026-09-30) gives sector Health Care and sub-industry Health Care Services (not Managed Health Care, where UNH, ELV, HUM and CNC sit); industry group and industry not listed there, left null. SEC SIC 6324.

hq.note: Per Wikipedia List of S&P 500 companies

employees.note: Approximately 67,700 employees worldwide, about 88% in the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Evernorth Health Services
businessLines.how: Clients (employers, health plans, government programs) pay Express Scripts per prescription processed plus a spread and rebates on drugs, and pay Accredo and care units for dispensing and managing high-cost specialty drugs; revenue scales with drug prices and volume, so it is mostly pass-through drug cost with a thin margin (about 3 percent of revenue).
businessLines.description: Pharmacy Benefit Services (Express Scripts: retail network, home delivery, rebate and formulary management) and Specialty and Care Services (Accredo specialty pharmacy, care and clinical services, Evernorth Care Group), with products such as the Evernorth Wholesale Marketplace and a rebate-free model.

revenue.note: Adjusted revenues; FY2024 202,155 (+16%). Pharmacy Benefit Services 132,126 (+18%); Specialty and Care Services 102,827 (+14%). Pharmacy claim volume 2,222 million (+5%). Q2 2026 61,468 vs 57,825 (+6%); H1 2026 119,910 vs 111,506.

businessLines.revenueNote: Adjusted revenues; FY2024 202,155 (+16%). Pharmacy Benefit Services 132,126 (+18%); Specialty and Care Services 102,827 (+14%). Pharmacy claim volume 2,222 million (+5%). Q2 2026 61,468 vs 57,825 (+6%); H1 2026 119,910 vs 111,506.

operatingProfit.note: Pre-tax adjusted income from operations; vs $7,001M in FY2024 (+3%). Pharmacy Benefit Services 3,506 (down 2%), Specialty and Care Services 3,715 (up 8%). Share is of $9,870M (sum of four segment/corporate lines: 7,221 + 4,153 + 89 - 1,593), computed here. H1 2026: 3,129 vs 3,130.

businessLines.name: Cigna Healthcare
businessLines.how: Most customers are employers who fund their own claims; Cigna earns a per-employee monthly administrative fee for network access and claims processing. For insured plans, premiums are collected and claims paid, keeping the gap.
businessLines.description: US Healthcare (employer-sponsored medical plans for National Accounts, Middle Market, Select and Small employers, individual and family plans on and off exchanges, dental) and International Health (multinational employers and globally mobile individuals). Medicare Advantage, Part D and CareAllies were sold to HCSC on 2025-03-19.

revenue.note: Adjusted revenues; FY2024 52,914 (-11%, HCSC sale). Q2 2026 11,728 vs 10,754 (+9%).
